english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a parcel, box, or envelope that has been sent or received.

exampleSentences.english: I just received the package you sent.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我啱啱收到你寄嚟嘅包裹。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou2 nei5 gei3 lai4 ge3 baau1 gwo2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a wrapped package being sent or transported.

exampleSentences.english: This parcel is being sent to you.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 baau1 gwo2 hai6 gei3 bei2 nei5 ge3
